newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria eases vs mark on client forex buying.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria eases vs mark on client forex buying.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev eased to 996-997 per mark at the close from the opening's 995-996 as foreign currency demand from energy importers rose, traders said.
* Importers bid for large dollar volumes, while supply lagged. Local traders calculate the lev/dollar trough the currency board lev/mark peg of 1,000 and the mark/dollar on global markets.
* The lev edged down to 1,830-1,834 to the dollar from the opening's 1,829-1,834, in line with the weaker mark/dollar.
